summary: Setup rolls resolved: era, opening situation, System origin. Tables and results in hidden/GM_LEDGER.md.
The System's seed: a shard of a Sith-alchemical tally holocron, woken on Dovrenn.
Garrick Tolliver unearthed the shard in Silo Three. Its first awards fell on the drover-dogs; the pack is altered, mimics voices heard over the comm, alpha Biscuit. Six settlers missing.
Warden Tolliver believes the thing listens to the comm and learns whom to call back as.
The pack hunts after dusk. Next review: one hour after dusk, Day 1.

Wick told the truth as he knows it; he does not know about the shard. The verbatim repeat is the pack's pattern: it replays recordings, it does not compose. Wick is wavering about answering the voice and is one more repeat from bolting. Ruddick lifts in 8 minutes unless persuaded or ordered.

Five of nine dogs at the treeline: one voice-dog, four lying in wait along the lane (bait and ambush). Biscuit and three others are NOT visible (roll_t1_7 = 4); their location is unrolled and must be decided by roll when it matters. The voice-dog replays recordings and answers to no new input. Pack has not noticed Aero (roll_t1_5 = 22 vs passive 13).
